SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE
Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices
something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels
and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
ARUNI - Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE:
EKAMA SAKSHIYA.

SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van. On the
dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message
plays.
ARUNI - Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan
baya hithenawa.
Mudalali calls. Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna. Dinu looks at the
red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES
Six hours earlier. Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the
C-17 key.
NIMAL - Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.
DINU - Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.
NIMAL - Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa
oyawa atharinnawa.
Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand. Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.

A Colombo cash-transfer driver steals Rs. 300 million after witnessing his closest friend's
murder, then returns to his village with the woman he loves to expose the corrupt network that
destroyed them.

rules.text:
Colombo palette - Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and
crowded backgrounds.

Village palette - Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer
silences.
Love scenes - 50mm and 85mm lenses, shallow focus and minimal camera movement.
Action lenses - 24mm for geography, 35mm for movement and 50mm for emotional impact.
Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.

Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.
Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
The action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.

brief.title: The canal gate
brief.summary: Aruni discovers Nimal's body and a marked key enclosed in his hand. Her attempt to reach Dinu goes unanswered.
brief.purpose: Establish the death and the key as linked mysteries while leaving Dinu unreachable.

people.wants: Understand the discovery and reach Dinu.

blocks.intent: Move from an ordinary journey to recognition of the dead man.
blocks.delivery_hint: Allow recognition to register without an abrupt expressive flourish.

events.change: Her progress beside the fields is interrupted by a discovery.

blocks.intent: Express distress through contact rather than an outcry.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the physical response small and deliberate.
blocks.text: She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand.

blocks.delivery_hint: Make the marking legible while preserving the stillness.

blocks.intent: Leave the surrounding world audible against her isolation.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the remote traffic sound embedded in the weather.

blocks.intent: End the discovery before any explanation arrives.

brief.title: The redirected van
brief.summary: Dinu hears Aruni's concern about Nimal while driving. Mudalali then orders a different destination, and Dinu changes course after looking at his wrist thread.
brief.purpose: Bring personal concern and an employer's demand into the same journey without establishing a causal link between them.

people.wants: Continue his journey while taking in the message and new instructions.
Alert Dinu to Nimal's absence and obtain reassurance.

blocks.intent: Establish Dinu at work within the wet city.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the driving contained rather than presenting it as a chase.
blocks.text: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van.

events.change: Dinu is established driving through illuminated wet streets.

blocks.intent: Establish an existing personal bond through a keepsake.
blocks.delivery_hint: Let the photograph register without treating the pictured people as present.
blocks.text: On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop.

events.change: A dashboard photograph associates Dinu and Aruni with a shared village memory.

blocks.intent: Bring Aruni into the journey through recorded audio.
blocks.delivery_hint: Distinguish playback from a live exchange.

scenes.heading: SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES

brief.title: The garage handoff
brief.summary: Earlier, Nimal presents material concerning Mudalali's money. Dinu objects to taking it, but Nimal presses him through his relationship with Aruni and places the key in his hand.
brief.purpose: Establish the key's earlier custody and Dinu's moral resistance without resolving whether he accepts Nimal's proposal.

people.wants: Persuade Dinu to participate in taking the money.
Resist becoming morally equivalent to the men Nimal condemns.

blocks.intent: Move the chronology backward relative to the van journey.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the temporal shift clear without adding a new event.
blocks.text: Six hours earlier.

blocks.intent: Present tangible support for Nimal's proposal.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the contents readable without inventing their details.
blocks.text: Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the C-17 key.

events.change: Opening the container exposes the key alongside photographic and financial material.

blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.intent: Identify the money and justify targeting it through its alleged origin.
blocks.delivery_hint: Direct and certain.
blocks.text: Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.

events.change: Nimal attributes the money to Mudalali's extraction from village development work.

blocks.speaker: C01
blocks.intent: Reject the moral distinction Nimal uses to support taking the money.
blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet but firm.
blocks.text: Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.

events.change: Dinu explicitly challenges the proposed taking.

blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.intent: Shift the argument from money to Dinu's fear and attachment to Aruni.
blocks.delivery_hint: Personal and pressing rather than reassuring.
blocks.text: Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa oyawa atharinnawa.

events.change: Nimal uses the possibility of losing Aruni to challenge Dinu's hesitation.

blocks.intent: Make the entrustment physical without treating it as agreement.
blocks.delivery_hint: Show a deliberate handoff at normal speed.

blocks.intent: Leave Dinu's decision unresolved.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold his attention on the object beneath the roof's rain ambience.

events.change: Dinu studies the key without a stated commitment.
